findings.text: _units_named_in rebuilds the unit id as f"s{int(...)}" instead of resolving through reckon/_plan_html.py:90 section_record_id, whose SECTION_NUMBER_PATTERN at reckon/_plan_html.py:83 accepts dotted sub-sections; a finding naming §5.1 therefore blocks s5 (or, where the plan carries only s5-1, blocks nothing at all and the finding never holds its section).

_fragment_unit returns the anchor fragment verbatim, so an anchor such as #Delivery names no unit in a plan whose section identity is the casefolded 'delivery' (reckon/_plan_html.py:103), and the finding silently blocks nothing.

The fragment states the importer population gives 54 passed at the head arm, but the run records only after-suite.log, baseline-suite.log and negative-control.log, and none of them carries a head importer run, so the head figure cannot be checked by a reader.

The done_when names the stored design review plan-a-read-costs-what-changed.v7.json as the fixture input, and the node substitutes findings worded after a-project-reads-as-one-picture because that record is absent from the tree and its history; the disclosure is honest and the resolver behaviour is measured, but the input the plan named is not the one exercised.
